scripts.build: rm -rf dist && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/runtime build && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/dashboard build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/cli build && rm -rf dist-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist-test/test/*.test.js
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/runtime build && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/dashboard build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
